rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.requirement: Rent for RSO units may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage published by LAHD. Additional increases require LAHD approval through programs such as capital improvement, primary renovation, seismic retrofit, rehabilitation, and just and reasonable rent increase. Rent may go to market rate after certain vacancies.
rules.key_value: Once every 12 months by the allowable percentage published by LAHD; no utility add-on or dependent-based 10% increase since 2026-02-02
rules.status_basis: Page describes the ordinance as in force; specific enactment dates are not stated.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, including apartments, duplexes, and similar units.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Condominiums and townhomes are not rent-regulated for tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) just cause eviction provisions
rules.requirement: RSO tenancies may be ended only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. No-fault evictions require a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict filed with LAHD, 30-day and 60-day written notice, and tenant relocation assistance. All termination notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service.
